previous_audits.verdict_rationale: The runner genuinely checks the finite-dimensional transfer and trace identities rather than merely printing expected results. However, its fork_bookkeeping function stipulates Z_d = 2 or 1 and pi_over_g = 1, so it verifies consequences of the proposed fork rather than deriving its exhaustiveness or normalization. The registrability authority explicitly leaves weighting, normalization, physical-readout identification, and related occupancy content outside its theorem, so it cannot close that missing bridge.
